entries.land_location_as_stated: on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine
entries.description: Seasonal women's guest house with 3 rooms at reasonable rates, on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. Quiet retreat with 2 lesbians.
entries.raw_text: PO Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5076. Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place. We are: 2 lesbians.
entries.notes: Type: guest house offering rooms to visitors, 'Just a quiet retreat', so Retreat/Gathering Space. Land city inferred as Stonington from the mailing address and 'small town' on the island; PO box so no street or zip. Accepted groups: Lesbian women because the 'We are: 2 lesbians' live there; no welcome list. Residents blank: 'We are: 2 lesbians' without 'living on the land', so count 2 not used. Acreage not given. Womyn's Guest House welcomes guests generally but no groups are named.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea
entries.description: Guest house for women on 18 acres of fields and woods in mid-coast Maine, with lodging, home-cooked meals, farm animals, vegetable, herb and flower gardens, and partial work exchange. Welcomes non-lesbian women. No drugs or alcohol.
entries.raw_text: RFD 2 Box 277, Lincolnville, ME 04849 (207)338-1913 (Northport, ME). Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. We welcome: nonlesbian women. No drugs or alcohol. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 'a guest house for women', defined by what it offers visitors, so Retreat/Gathering Space. Land address: rural route (RFD) so mailing address is the land. Accepted groups: 'We welcome: nonlesbian women' names Non-lesbian women; Lesbian women added because the directory is for lesbians and women live and work on the land. Recovery/substance-free: 'No drugs or alcohol.' Farming/self-sufficiency: farm animals and vegetable, herb and flower gardens as part of the place, though thin. Residents blank: number not given.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the Blue Mountains; in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail
entries.description: Vacation cabin for rent in the Blue Mountains of Pennsylvania, sleeping 7, on 2 acres in State Game Lands near the Appalachian Trail. Welcomes new residents, children, non-lesbian women, males and dogs.
entries.raw_text: c/o Barbara Hart, RD #1 Box 1446, Hamburg, PA 19526 (215)373-5697. Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch country. Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day. We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type: rental vacation cabin defined by what it offers visitors, so Retreat/Gathering Space (not Private Land despite 2 lesbians). Land address: rural route (RD), so mailing address is the land. Accepted groups: 'girl & boy children' gives Girl children and Boy children; 'nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women; 'males' with no orientation gives Gay men and Non-gay men; Lesbian women because 2 lesbians are listed. Residents blank: '2 lesbians' with no statement that women live on the land.

entries.description: Small lesbian residential community of 10 separately owned cottages with a cultural/spiritual center, feminist library and health food store, on the ocean in St Augustine. Only lesbians can rent or own; all women may become members and stay in the center. 15 resident lesbians plus 90 members.
entries.raw_text: 207 Coastal Hwy, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 'small lesbian residential community' living on its own property, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Land address: street address, so mailing address is the land. Residents: '15 resident lesbians' (90 members from all over are not counted). Accepted groups: 'girl children' gives Girl children; 'nonlesbian women visitors' gives Non-lesbian women; Lesbian women because residents are lesbians. Focuses: Archives/cultural work from 'feminist library'; Spirituality/ritual from 'cultural/spiritual center'. Not coded as separatism: 'Only lesbians can rent or own' but all women may be members and stay. Smoking and alcohol rules apply only to the main floor, so no Recovery/substance-free. Acreage not given.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan; on Long Lake
entries.description: Inexpensive wilderness resort for women in northwest Michigan on Long Lake, with three cabins on 1 acre. The owners are seeking women to invest in property and dream of an all-woman community with campground, lodge for workshops and more cabins. Welcomes new residents, girl children, boys under 12 and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 (616)882-5994 (4115 M-22). Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: 'wilderness resort for women', defined by what it offers visitors, so Retreat/Gathering Space; the community is only a dream. Land address: rural route, so mailing address is the land. Residents: '2 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups: 'girl children, boy children under 12' gives Girl children and Boy children (condition: boys under 12); 'nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women; Lesbian women because lesbians live there. Workshops/education: planned 'community lodge for workshops'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis; by the Illinois River
entries.description: Scenic, secluded retreat on the Illinois River north of Kampsville, IL, on 14 acres, for individuals and small groups; caters to women, especially lesbians. The proprietor is a counselor who offers groups and retreats. Welcomes new residents, children, non-lesbian women and males.
entries.raw_text: 187 W 19th St, Alton, IL 62002 (618)462-4051 or 653-4349 (retreat) or (314)773-3867 (St Louis). Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type: calls itself a retreat, so Retreat/Gathering Space. Mailing address is a street address in Alton, but the land is described as north of Kampsville, so land street, city and zip are left blank; state IL from the listing. Accepted groups: 'girl & boy children' gives Girl children and Boy children; 'nonlesbian women' gives Non-lesbian women; 'males' gives Gay men and Non-gay men; Lesbian women because 4 lesbians and the retreat 'caters to women, especially lesbians'. Residents blank: '4 lesbians' but women live only 'part-time' on the land, count noted not used.
